## CredentialsModule.proposeCredential() method

Initiate a new credential exchange as holder by sending a credential proposal message to the connection with the specified connection id.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
proposeCredential(connectionId: string, config?: CredentialProposeOptions): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

| Parameter    | Type                                                           | Description                                                        |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| connectionId | string                                                         | The connection to send the credential proposal to                  |
